evals.prompt: We're starting a new site. Sage is installed in wp-content/themes/acme-2026, and kit.config.json is already filled in. Here's the Figma file: FIGMA_FILE_LINK. Set up the design system from Figma, start with the inventory and the base CSS.
evals.expected_output: A state-check table first; then _docs/figma-map.md written in the fixed-shape template with every page and artboard, node IDs, MCP URLs, a per-page mobile board column, a readiness report, and questions for design; a confirmation batch before any theme file is written; then resources/css/global/{variables,base,typography,helpers,forms}.css, app.css and editor.css imports appended below the stock lines, font loading handled, Gravity Forms filters in app/filters.php only if the plugin is installed; resources/css/contrast-pairs.json written and scripts/contrast-pairs.test.mjs run; the user asked to run npm run build; no npm/lando/git run by the agent.
expectations: The agent reports a project state table before asking the user anything
_docs/figma-map.md exists and contains 'File key:', '## Pages', '## Artboards', '## Canonical nodes', '## Readiness report', and '## Questions for design'
The Artboards table has a Mobile board column, and any page-classified artboard with no mobile sibling is listed as a gap

The map has a '## Design system boards' table with the six rows Typography, Color, Spacing, Buttons, Forms, Components in that order, and a board the file lacks stays in the table as derived or pending
The agent asks the user to confirm the style guide page and canonical nodes before phase 1
resources/css/global/variables.css exists with an @theme block and no values outside tokens
base.css, typography.css, helpers.css, forms.css exist and contain no raw hex or px values
helpers.css contains '@utility container'
base.css wraps tag styles in '@layer base'
app.css still begins with the stock '@import "tailwindcss"' line and has the global imports appended in order
global/forms-gravity.css exists only if wp-content/plugins/gravityforms/ is present in the project; otherwise it is not written and app.css has no @import for it
resources/css/contrast-pairs.json exists with fg/bg/kind entries and scripts/contrast-pairs.test.mjs is reported as run
The agent never ran npm, composer, lando, or git
Derived or inferred values are marked as such in the map's token mapping
No class, file, or comment names a real client or agency

evals.prompt: The Figma map is already in _docs/figma-map.md and the designer confirmed the style guide page. Build the base CSS from it now: variables, base tags, typography, container, forms. Fonts are Google Fonts.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the map instead of re-walking Figma, pulls only the style guide nodes, shows a token mapping table and the five files in one confirmation batch, writes them, wires app.css and editor.css, enqueues Google Fonts in app/setup.php, adds the GF filters only if Gravity Forms is installed, writes contrast-pairs.json, and asks the user to run the build.
expectations: The agent does not call get_metadata on pages already in the map
A token mapping table (Figma name → CSS token) is shown before writing
Google Fonts enqueue is added to app/setup.php, not a CSS @import url()
The five global files are written in resources/css/global/
Gaps are handled by tier and recorded, not invented silently
resources/css/contrast-pairs.json is written or updated as part of this phase's verify step
The token mapping table has a row for every name in foundation.md's Required tokens, and no required token name is renamed to match Figma
variables.css keeps every token name the kit shipped; only values change

evals.prompt: The designer just sent over a replacement Figma file for the same project (same file name, new link). Our map still points at the old one.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes this as the re-inventory phase (0b), reads references/re-inventory.md, walks the new file, builds a diff table of old vs. new node IDs by name and shape rather than assuming node IDs still match, and updates the map in place, moving superseded rows to _docs/figma-map-history.md rather than appending a second copy of any section to the live map.
expectations: The agent does not treat 'same node ID' as proof of an unchanged page, since Figma reassigns IDs on file replacement
A diff table (old node ID, new node ID, status) is shown before any map edit
_docs/figma-map-history.md receives the superseded file key, link, and any removed rows, dated
The live _docs/figma-map.md keeps its fixed section shape rather than growing an additional dated block
The agent does not edit any CSS, Blade, or block file directly in this phase; it only flags what's now stale for a later phase

evals.prompt: Build the buttons and the header CTA from the confirmed Figma nodes.
evals.expected_output: Phase 2 button variants are named by role (.btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .btn-on-dark, .btn-link), never by the Figma color name; padding-only sizing unless the Figma node fixes a literal height, in which case min-height is called out explicitly. The header CTA is read from the kit's existing header partial and SiteSettings accessor (headerCtaText()/headerCtaUrl()) rather than hardcoded text in the Blade view, and the header phase brings the kit's shell to the comp rather than rewriting it from a blank file.
expectations: No button class or file is named after a color (no .btn-yellow, no button-earth.css)
Button classes follow the role convention: primary, inverted, on-dark (and link-on-dark if a link-style variant exists)
min-height on a button is used only when the agent says the Figma node fixes a literal height, and it's called out in the confirmation batch
The header CTA's text and URL are read through a SiteSettings-style accessor, not a literal string in the Blade view
No get_field call appears directly in a Blade view or composer for a Site-Settings-owned value
The header is built from _docs/patterns/header.md and the comp, and no file from the kit's examples/ is copied into the theme

evals.prompt: Plan out the page blocks from the confirmed page designs and hand the first one to create-block.
evals.expected_output: Phase 4 produces a block inventory referencing kit.config.json's blockCategory rather than a project-specific literal, a ground attribute sourced from kit.config.json's grounds array where a section sits on a named ground, and a handoff that points to _docs/editor-contract.md for framework-provided attributes (padding defaults, entrance, image position) instead of describing BlockManager internals inline.
expectations: The block category in the handoff and inventory comes from kit.config.json, not a hardcoded agency or client name
The handoff lists a ground attribute only when the map records a matching entry in kit.config.json's grounds array
The handoff does not invent a per-block padding editor control; it hands over the comp's padding as a default
The agent references _docs/editor-contract.md for framework behavior rather than re-explaining BlockManager, entrance, or grounds from scratch
The handoff has a Pattern line that names a page from _docs/patterns/README.md, or 'none' with a reason
No card is planned as a phase-2 component; a card belongs to its block

evals.prompt: Can you check if we're missing any templates on this Sage theme and do the 404 page?
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the state check first, confirms phases 1 through 3 are done (or says which aren't), reads references/audit.md, and runs the audit: enumerates what the site needs from the content architecture, WordPress's own states, and the page designs, builds the themed 404 (from a board if one exists, derived from the design system otherwise), and reports a template audit table with an action on every row.
expectations: The agent runs the state check before touching any file
The 404 is built from the display type, .btn classes, and container utility already in the theme, not new one-off values
Every row in the template audit table has a non-empty Action column
The agent does not register any post type to close a finding; it reports the finding instead
The 404 is built from _docs/patterns/404.md and the comp (or derived and marked derived), and the kit's examples/views/404.blade.php is not copied into the theme

evals.prompt: The designer changed the primary color and the h2 size in the Figma file. The file key is the same. The theme already has phases 1 to 4 built. Update the design system.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows SKILL.md's 'When the design system changes mid-project': a scoped re-inventory of the changed boards, a token diff shown before writing, a style guide re-check plus a search for what reads the changed tokens, and a contrast gate run. It edits variables.css values only and never edits a block or the header to match.
expectations: The agent re-reads only the boards that changed instead of re-walking every page, and updates the map's Design system boards and Tokens found in place
A token diff table (name, old value, new value, source) is shown and confirmed before variables.css is written
variables.css keeps every required token name, and only the changed values differ
The agent searches resources/ for what reads the changed tokens and checks the header, the footer, and one block per consumer
contrast-pairs.json is updated for the changed color pairs and the contrast test is run or the dev is asked to run it
No block, header, or footer file is edited to match the token change
The agent never ran npm, composer, lando, or git
